description: This file declares functions and external variables related to low-memory management for the Duktape JavaScript engine, including memory initialization, cleanup, dumping, and wrapped allocation functions.

methods.name: lowmem_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with low-memory management.

methods.name: lowmem_dump
methods.description: Dumps current state of low-memory usage for debugging.

methods.name: lowmem_register
methods.description: Registers a Duktape context with the low-memory subsystem.

methods.name: lowmem_start_exec_timeout
methods.description: Starts execution timeout for low-memory operations.

methods.name: lowmem_alloc_wrapped
methods.description: Allocates memory with low-memory management wrappers.

methods.name: lowmem_realloc_wrapped
methods.description: Reallocates memory with low-memory management wrappers.

methods.name: lowmem_free_wrapped
methods.description: Frees memory allocated with wrapped allocation functions.
